==Description==
'''Tropical Industries''' is a {{Color|Normal}} [[Maps|map]] set on a tropical island.

==Design & Path==
'''Tropical Industries''' is an industrial map set on a tropical island. The island is split into two parts by a river body. The first area is grassy. It has multiple palm trees with coconuts, cliffs and lights. The second area is a lot more industrial. It is surrounded by fences and cliffs. Most of the grass is replaced by grey concrete. A few lights and scaffolding can be seen there. There are also two large industrial buildings, one made out of red bricks with a black roof, black windows, grey doors and three smokestacks. The second building has white walls, red roof, with multiple entrances to it and a lightning bolt emblem.

The path starts at a cave and ends at a large factory. It is a winding path which goes around the grassy area and then crosses the bridge, which leads into the industrial area of the map.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*As this map has a curvy path there are a lot decent spots for ground towers on the entire map.
**Because of its shape, there are also multiple great spots for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], with the best one being at the back of the map, which allows them to cover some part of the path for most of their flight path.
*This map has a large amount of cliff spots, though they are generally on the side of the map, reducing their path coverage.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at increasing their range.
